extracted_concepts.name: 正数和负数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers greater than zero and less than zero used to represent opposite quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: 有理数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers that can be expressed as a fraction p/q where p and q are integers and q≠0.

extracted_concepts.name: 数轴
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A straight line with a chosen origin, direction, and unit length to represent numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: 相反数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two numbers that have the same absolute value but opposite signs.

extracted_concepts.name: 绝对值
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The non-negative magnitude of a number without regard to its sign.

extracted_concepts.name: 有理数的加减法
aliases: addition and subtraction of rational numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operations combining rational numbers using addition and subtraction rules.

extracted_concepts.name: 有理数的乘除法
aliases: multiplication and division of rational numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operations combining rational numbers using multiplication and division rules.

extracted_concepts.name: 有理数的乘方
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Repeated multiplication of a rational number by itself.

extracted_concepts.name: 整式
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An algebraic expression consisting of variables and coefficients, involving only addition, subtraction, and multiplication.

extracted_concepts.name: 整式的加减
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Combining like terms in polynomial expressions through addition or subtraction.

extracted_concepts.name: 一元一次方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An equation containing one variable raised to the first power.

extracted_concepts.name: 解一元一次方程
aliases: solving linear equations in one variable
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of finding the value of the variable that satisfies a linear equation.

extracted_concepts.name: 几何图形
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Shapes and structures defined by points, lines, and surfaces in space.

extracted_concepts.name: 直线
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A straight one-dimensional figure having no thickness and extending infinitely in both directions.

extracted_concepts.name: 射线
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A part of a line that starts at a point and extends infinitely in one direction.

extracted_concepts.name: 线段
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A part of a line bounded by two distinct endpoints.

extracted_concepts.name: 角
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The figure formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint.

extracted_concepts.name: 相交线
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Lines that cross each other at exactly one point.

extracted_concepts.name: 平行线
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Lines in a plane that do not meet, maintaining constant distance.

extracted_concepts.name: 平移
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A geometric transformation moving every point of a figure by the same distance in a given direction.

extracted_concepts.name: 平方根
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that when multiplied by itself gives the original number.

extracted_concepts.name: 立方根
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that when multiplied by itself three times gives the original number.

extracted_concepts.name: 实数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The set of all rational and irrational numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: 有序数对
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A pair of numbers (a, b) where order matters, used to locate points in a plane.

extracted_concepts.name: 平面直角坐标系
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A two-dimensional coordinate system formed by two perpendicular number axes.

extracted_concepts.name: 二元一次方程组
aliases: system of linear equations in two variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A set of two linear equations with two variables.

extracted_concepts.name: 消元法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A technique for solving systems of equations by eliminating one variable.

extracted_relations.evidence: 数轴用于直观表示有理数的位置和大小关系。
相反数是有理数集合中关于原点对称的特定元素。
绝对值是定义在有理数上的非负属性。
加减运算规则直接依赖于有理数的符号和分数形式。
乘除运算法则建立在有理数定义之上。
乘方是有理数重复相乘的扩展运算。
合并同类项和去括号操作以整式结构为基础。
方程化简与移项过程需熟练运用整式运算。
求解步骤专门针对含单一一次变量的方程设计。
直线是构成平面几何的基本图形元素。
射线是直线上一点及其一侧的部分。
线段是直线上两点间的有限部分。
角的定义由两条共端点的射线构成。
相交关系描述了两条直线在平面内的位置交互。
平行关系描述了两条直线永不相交的特性。
平移变换作用于几何图形以改变其位置而不改变形状。
平方根运算是实数体系中的重要代数概念。
立方根运算是实数体系中的扩展代数概念。
实数集是有理数集与无理数集的并集。
有序数对唯一确定平面直角坐标系中的一个点。
坐标系为几何图形的解析表示提供框架。
二元方程组可通过消元降维转化为一元方程求解。
消元法是解二元一次方程组的标准核心算法。
解方程过程中的移项与合并同类项依赖有理数加减。
解方程过程中的系数化一依赖有理数乘除。
相交线产生的邻补角和对顶角是本章核心考点。
平移性质常与平行线的判定和性质结合应用。
